scope: bounded static mechanical diagnostic; no integration, optimization or physical calibration

dwell_summary.disclaimer: quasi-static host-command balance, not measured torque; static friction/contact or output scale may contribute; no inference of pure motor lag. Every 500-sample dwell includes one or two scope0 rows, delivery not confirmed.

diagnostic_method.seven_pose_check: Replay.state_at at 3 model-blind legacy validation starts (selection rows 0,8,16), left/right PD segment9 midpoints, and two explicit documented zero hypotheses. Static qvel=0 for force projection; no optimization or integration. T from Replay.state_at closure finite differences. gravity generalized hold=T.T@qfrc_bias; gas=T.T@qfrc_actuator; hold=gravity-gas. Unit slider displacement pin length derivative via +/-1e-6m; beta derivative via +1e-6 rad active coordinate. Any-orientation gravity bound=norm of projected gravity components under 9.81*unit x/y/z.
diagnostic_method.dwell_check: Unchanged LegacyReplay.static_load_audit: complete segments>=1000 rows, reference peak-to-peak<=1e-8rad, last500 rows velocity RMS<=.08rad/s, evaluate median-index closure state and mean host torque. No dynamical motor parameters introduced. 31 qualify; exclude nominal beta>=104, require enable_all and scope1_fraction>=.995 ->30. Every free dwell has 499/500 scope1 rows; one scope0 row retained, host-command interpretation explicit.
diagnostic_method.field_caution: static_load_audit inherited measured_command_nm field means host controller command here, not independent measured shaft torque. Hypothetical zero rows have no associated observed torque or velocity.
